findings.text: The company was wound up on 11 September 2024 in a members' voluntary liquidation, with a declaration of solvency made on 9 September 2024.
The accounts are overdue; they were last made up to 31 December 2023 and the next accounts are due by 30 September 2025.
The confirmation statement is overdue; it was last made up to 17 November 2023 and the next statement was due by 1 December 2024.
The company was incorporated on 24 December 1979 and is 46.8 years old.
There are 2 current officers: 1 director (PERSON 728) and 1 other officer.
One person with significant control is recorded: PERSON 729, an individual with significant influence or control as a firm.
No charges are registered against the company.
No registered office address changes or officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 26 October 2025.
